## Review

**A enjoyable and absorbing strategy and role play game that enables you to experience the live of the famous heroic outlaw Robin Hood**

An enthralling and diverting role-play game that enables you to explore and enjoy the English landscape of 1190, scale giant castles and meet amusing characters.

Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood is an addictive strategy game that can be bought for $9.99 from the Mac App Store. The installation process is simple and straightforward and will require approximately 900 MB from your Mac's hard disk space.

Robin Hood is a highly skilled swordsman and archer that it is known for robbing from the rich in order to give to the poor. The hero is always assisted by a group of faithful vassals that you can use in the battle field against the evil Prince John.

Right from the start you will be introduced into the hero's live as you try to complete the first mission in which you have to free your comrades. Thus, you will take control of one of the most known thief and use your strategy thinking along with the fighting skills to face your arch enemy, Prince John Lackland.

As you try to lead the battle against Prince's oppressing reign and free the farmers you also have to save King Richard who has been kidnapped for a large ransom. Your strategy and dexterity skills will be tested as you climb the castle walls during the night to loot the rich. You also have to prove your fighting skills during sword fights and use Robin's archer skills to defeat your enemy.

Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood features a nonlinear story line that allows you to take important decisions with direct impact on the outcome of your adventure. You also have to adapt your gaming style according to the encountered situation to avoid embarrassing defeats and achieve victory.

All in all, Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood is an absorbing RPG that will test your gaming skills and keep you on the edge of the seat during complex and engaging battles.
